package.name: moveit_sim_bridge
package.description: Bridges MoveIt's trajectory/gripper execution (FollowJointTrajectory, GripperCommand) to this project's own sim arm command topic (arm_0/joint_command), since the simulated arm has no real ros2_control hardware interface for move_group's moveit_simple_controller_manager to talk to. Also the arm helpers arm_goto (SRDF named states through move_group) and arm_joints (commanded vs. observed joints), which work on a real robot too.
